This tab is reserved so the right-side d.en: This tab is reserved so the right-side deck keeps one stable structure across families.

Toggle shoreline, basin contour, and tex.zh: 切换活动场景的海岸线、盆地轮廓和纹理叠加。

Treat saving and exporting as two separa.en: Treat saving and exporting as two separate handoff steps: save the editable project first, then export the publishable image or layer package.
Treat saving and exporting as two separa.zh: 把保存和导出当成两个独立交接步骤：先保存可继续编辑的项目，再导出可发布的图片或图层包。

Tune the visual language of the main map.en: Tune the visual language of the main map.

Turn on Show Transport Overview, choose.zh: 打开“显示交通概览”，选择分布、网络或覆盖，再调整各类交通的可见性、标签和范围。

Turns road reference labels on or off..en: Turns road reference labels on or off.
Turns road reference labels on or off..zh: 打开或关闭道路参考标签。

Upload a local image, align it with opac.zh: 上传一张本地地图图片，用下方的透明度、缩放和偏移把它对齐。对齐参数会随项目保存；重新打开项目时需要再次上传图片。

Upload a local map image, then align it.en: Upload a local map image, then align it with opacity, scale and offset.
Upload a local map image, then align it.zh: 上传本地地图图片，再用透明度、缩放和偏移对齐。

Upload the image, set opacity for readab.en: Upload the image, set opacity for readability, adjust scale, then fine-tune horizontal and vertical offsets.
Upload the image, set opacity for readab.zh: 上传图像，先调透明度保证可读，再调缩放，最后微调水平和垂直偏移。

Use Activate Releasable or Reapply Core.en: Use Activate Releasable or Reapply Core Territory in Scenario Actions.
Use Activate Releasable or Reapply Core.zh: 请在 Scenario Actions 中使用“激活可释放国”或“重新应用核心领土”。

Use Activate for focused ownership chang.en: Use Activate for focused ownership changes and Scenario Actions for broader rule-driven updates. After each pass, re-check the View and Split chips.
Use Activate for focused ownership chang.zh: 小范围归属切换用“激活”，批量或规则化调整用“场景操作”。每轮完成后，再检查视图和拆分状态。

Use Activate or Scenario Actions for map.en: Use Activate or Scenario Actions for map edits, tune Appearance and Transport for readability, then save a project JSON before export.
Use Activate or Scenario Actions for map.zh: 用“激活”或“场景操作”修改地图，用“外观”和“交通”提高可读性，导出前保存项目 JSON。

Use Appearance for map readability and T.en: Use Appearance for map readability and Transport for routes, ports, airports, and network context.
Use Appearance for map readability and T.zh: 用“外观”提高地图可读性，用“交通”展示道路、港口、机场和网络背景。

Use Country Color for Visual Actions.en: Use Country Color for Visual Actions
Use Country Color for Visual Actions.zh: 使用国家颜色进行视觉操作

Use Download Project to save the current.en: Use Download Project to save the current editable state: scenario choice, ownership edits, appearance, transport, strategic annotations, reference alignment values, and export settings.
Use Download Project to save the current.zh: 使用“下载项目”保存当前可编辑状态：场景选择、归属修改、外观、交通、战略标注、参考图对齐参数和导出设置。

Use Frontline after you apply a scenario.en: Use Frontline after you apply a scenario. This section combines the derived conflict overlay with the project-local strategic workspace for operational lines, graphics, and unit counters.
Use Frontline after you apply a scenario.zh: 先应用场景，再使用 Frontline。这个区块同时管理 derived conflict overlay 和 project-local strategic workspace，用于 operational lines、graphics 和 unit counters。

Use Guide for workflow steps and Referen.en: Use Guide for workflow steps and Reference for visual alignment. Both stay in the Project tab so you can check instructions without losing context.
Use Guide for workflow steps and Referen.zh: 用 Guide 查看操作流程，用 Reference 做视觉对位。它们都留在 Project tab 里，这样你可以对照指引而不会丢失当前上下文。

Use Layer-based special zones for new ed.en: Use Layer-based special zones for new edits.
Use Layer-based special zones for new ed.zh: 新编辑请使用分层特殊区域。

Use Open workbench to choose the output.en: Use Open workbench to choose the output target, format, resolution, layer order, text stacks, and image adjustments. Export creates the final image, per-layer PNG set, or bake pack; it does not replace the editable project JSON.
Use Open workbench to choose the output.zh: 使用“打开工作台”选择输出目标、格式、分辨率、图层顺序、文字堆栈和图像调整。导出会生成最终图片、分层 PNG 或 bake pack；它不会替代可编辑的项目 JSON。

Use Project tools as a publish checklist.en: Use Project tools as a publish checklist: save the project, add strategic context, align references, then export.
Use Project tools as a publish checklist.zh: 把项目工具当成发布检查清单：先保存项目，再补战略信息、对齐参考图，最后导出。

Use an active owner for political action.en: Use an active owner for political actions
Use an active owner for political action.zh: 使用当前激活归属执行政治操作

Use broad edits and strategic marks deli.en: Use broad edits and strategic marks deliberately.
Use broad edits and strategic marks deli.zh: 谨慎使用大范围编辑和战略标记。

Use diagnostics to inspect geometry and.en: Use diagnostics to inspect geometry and artifact behavior.
Use diagnostics to inspect geometry and.zh: 使用诊断视图检查几何与异常行为。

Use explicit rules. Do not lean on fuzzy.en: Use explicit rules. Do not lean on fuzzy post-fix cleanup.
Use explicit rules. Do not lean on fuzzy.zh: 使用明确的规则。不要依赖模糊的修复后清理。

Use geographic anchors and dominant land.en: Use geographic anchors and dominant land context before falling back to fewer region labels.
Use geographic anchors and dominant land.zh: 在使用较少的区域标签之前，请使用地理锚点和主要土地背景。

Use geographic anchors and dominant logi.en: Use geographic anchors and dominant logistics function, then merge labels when corridor density spikes.
Use geographic anchors and dominant logi.zh: 使用地理锚点和主导物流功能，然后在走廊密度激增时合并标签。

Use line styles and fading to distinguis.en: Use line styles and fading to distinguish railway status. Keep main lines more prominent than branch and service lines.
Use line styles and fading to distinguis.zh: 用线型和淡化效果区分铁路状态，干线比支线和作业线更醒目。

Use official motorway refs when they exi.en: Use official motorway refs when they exist.
Use official motorway refs when they exi.zh: 如果存在官方高速公路参考，请使用它们。

Use official names when source values di.en: Use official names when source values disagree.
Use official names when source values di.zh: 当来源值不一致时使用官方名称。

Use official road names and route number.en: Use official road names and route numbers where available.
Use official road names and route number.zh: 有官方道路名称和路线编号时优先使用。

Use short intent lines and quiet caption.en: Use short intent lines and quiet captions so arrows support the frontline instead of overpowering it.
Use short intent lines and quiet caption.zh: 使用简短的意图线和低调标签，让箭头辅助前线而不是压过前线。

Use the bottom command bar for fast entr.en: Use the bottom command bar for fast entry, or start drawing here for the selected line type.
Use the bottom command bar for fast entr.zh: 可使用底部命令栏快速开始，或在此为所选线型开始绘制。

Use the center board to reorder the 8 tr.en: Use the center board to reorder the 8 transport families. The left column provides context, and the right column mirrors the current state.
Use the center board to reorder the 8 tr.zh: 在中间面板调整 8 个交通图层族的绘制顺序。左栏提供上下文，右栏显示当前状态。

Use the center frame to drag families in.en: Use the center frame to drag families into the order you want future transport layers to draw.
Use the center frame to drag families in.zh: 在中间面板拖动图层族，设定交通图层的绘制顺序。

Use the gear button for the full counter.en: Use the gear button for the full counter editor.
Use the gear button for the full counter.zh: 使用完整计数器编辑器的齿轮按钮。

Use the network and status controls to f.en: Use the network and status controls to focus the review.
Use the network and status controls to f.zh: 使用路网和状态控件缩小查看范围。

Use the workbench Display and Data tabs.en: Use the workbench Display and Data tabs to review live rail visibility rules, pack status, and reconciliation notes.
Use the workbench Display and Data tabs.zh: 在 workbench 的 Display 和 Data 页签里查看 rail 的当前可见性规则、pack 状态和 reconciliation 说明。

Use these tools for ownership edits, bat.en: Use these tools for ownership edits, batch changes, annotations, and source-aligned visual work.
Use these tools for ownership edits, bat.zh: 这些工具用于归属编辑、批量修改、标注，以及对齐来源资料的视觉工作。

Use this checklist when you want the sho.en: Use this checklist when you want the shortest safe editing path.
Use this checklist when you want the sho.zh: 需要最短、最稳的编辑路径时，先按下面的顺序操作。

Use this guide inside the support area s.en: Use this guide inside the support area so the shell stays quiet while the next step stays readable.
Use this guide inside the support area s.zh: 在支持区域内使用本指南，以便 shell 保持安静，同时下一步保持可读。

Use this panel to adjust the current fam.en: Use this panel to adjust the current family without changing the lens column context.
Use this panel to adjust the current fam.zh: 用此面板调整当前类别，保持视图列的上下文不变。

Use this section when the scenario uses.en: Use this section when the scenario uses HGO source data, HGO flags, or HGO country-name variants.
Use this section when the scenario uses.zh: 剧本使用 HGO 源数据、HGO 旗帜或 HGO 国家名称变体时，查看本节。

Very short projected segments drop out t.en: Very short projected segments drop out to reduce spark noise.
Very short projected segments drop out t.zh: 非常短的投影段会脱落，以减少火花噪音。

When off, macro ocean regions are ignore.zh: 关闭后，开放海洋大区将不再响应悬停、点击和涂色。

When off, macro ocean regions can be ins.en: When off, macro ocean regions can be inspected but ignore paint, eraser, and eyedropper actions.
When off, macro ocean regions can be ins.zh: 关闭后，宏观海洋区域仍可查看，但会忽略上色、橡皮和吸管操作。

When off, macro ocean regions stay hidde.en: When off, macro ocean regions stay hidden from inspector selection and map picking.
When off, macro ocean regions stay hidde.zh: 关闭后，宏观海洋区域不会出现在检视器选择和地图拾取中。

When off, scenario special regions are h.en: When off, scenario special regions are hidden and ignore hover, click, and paint.
When off, scenario special regions are h.zh: 关闭后，剧本特殊区域会被隐藏，并忽略悬停、点击和涂色。

When off, shoreline, basin contour, and.en: When off, shoreline, basin contour, and texture overlays are hidden for the active scenario.
When off, shoreline, basin contour, and.zh: 关闭后，当前剧本的海岸线、盆地等高线和纹理覆盖层将被隐藏。

When the selected country comes from HGO.en: When the selected country comes from HGO data, review its HGO names, flag option, and ideology label before changing ownership.
When the selected country comes from HGO.zh: 选中的国家来自 HGO 数据时，先检查 HGO 名称、旗帜选项和意识形态标签，再修改归属。

Whether branch lines participate at the.en: Whether branch lines participate at the current zoom gate.
Whether branch lines participate at the.zh: 支线是否参与当前缩放门。

You are about to change ownership, contr.zh: 准备修改归属、控制方、核心、标签或任意要素级状态时使用。

You are about to make broad ownership, f.en: You are about to make broad ownership, frontline, transport, or overlay changes.
You are about to make broad ownership, f.zh: 准备大范围修改归属、前线、交通或叠加层时使用。

You are preparing a final image, sharing.en: You are preparing a final image, sharing the scenario with another editor, or archiving a stable milestone.
You are preparing a final image, sharing.zh: 准备最终图片、把场景交给其他编辑者，或归档稳定阶段时使用。

You have unsaved changes. Loading a proj.en: You have unsaved changes. Loading a project will replace the current map.
You have unsaved changes. Loading a proj.zh: 你有未保存的更改。加载项目会覆盖当前地图。

You need a recovery point, a handoff fil.en: You need a recovery point, a handoff file, or a before-and-after checkpoint before a broad edit.
You need a recovery point, a handoff fil.zh: 需要恢复点、交接文件，或在大改前保留前后对照时使用。

You need routes, hubs, ports, airports,.en: You need routes, hubs, ports, airports, or infrastructure density visible beside political ownership.
You need routes, hubs, ports, airports,.zh: 需要在政治归属旁边显示路线、枢纽、港口、机场或基础设施密度时使用。

You need to compare the active map again.en: You need to compare the active map against HGO geography or confirm that the selected feature belongs to the expected source region.
You need to compare the active map again.zh: 需要对照当前地图和 HGO 地理，或确认选中要素属于预期来源区域时使用。

You need to trace historical borders, co.en: You need to trace historical borders, compare a source map, or keep a visual planning layer beside the scenario.
You need to trace historical borders, co.zh: 需要描摹历史边界、对照来源地图，或在场景旁保留视觉规划层时使用。

Zoom out and zoom in once; borders, citi.en: Zoom out and zoom in once; borders, cities, water, and terrain should stay readable at both scales.
Zoom out and zoom in once; borders, citi.zh: 缩小和放大各看一次；边界、城市、水域和地形在两个尺度下都应清楚。

Zoom percentage must be between 100% and.en: Zoom percentage must be between 100% and 5000%.
Zoom percentage must be between 100% and.zh: 缩放百分比必须在 100% 到 5000% 之间。

Zoom percentage must be between 35% and.zh: 缩放百分比必须介于 35% 到 5000% 之间。

features added from country / owner filt.zh: 个要素已通过国家 / 属主筛选加入。

presets moved to Releasable Countries..zh: 个预设已移动到“可释放国家”中。

startup.readonly.failed.en: Detailed interactions are unavailable right now. The map stays view-only until the detail layer recovers.
startup.readonly.failed.zh: 细分交互暂时不可用。在细分图层恢复前，地图将保持只读。

startup.readonly.healthGate.en: Scenario data is being held in safe mode. The map stays view-only until startup recovery finishes.
